# AdhocX

> AdhocX is a B2B corporate ground-transport platform based in Hyderabad, India. It combines employee transport software (ETS) with a network of verified commercial yellow-plate 4-seater and 7-seater cabs, so companies can run shift commutes, night-shift transport for women employees, executive and airport transfers, and monthly corporate cab rental with GPS tracking and consolidated GST billing.

AdhocX is operated by Estemporaneo Technologies Private Limited. Primary service area: Hyderabad (HITEC City, Gachibowli, Financial District, Madhapur) and Telangana. Site: https://www.adhocx.com. Contact details: https://www.adhocx.com/contact

## Services and product
- [Employee transport services](https://www.adhocx.com/services): shift pickups and drops, night-shift safety, executive and airport cabs for corporates.
- [Employee Transport Software (ETS)](https://www.adhocx.com/ets): route planning, corporate client portal, employee app, driver app, live GPS tracking.
- [Corporate cab sourcing and fleet rental](https://www.adhocx.com/vendors): 4-seater and 7-seater yellow-plate fleets, SLA-backed fulfilment.
- [Industries served](https://www.adhocx.com/industries): IT parks, BPO and GCC night shifts, BFSI, healthcare.
- [Pricing](https://www.adhocx.com/pricing): corporate contract pricing, monthly rates, automated billing.
- [Safety and compliance](https://www.adhocx.com/safety): night escort protocols, women-employee safety, verified drivers and vehicles.

## Apps
- [Employee app](https://www.adhocx.com/employee-app): cab booking, live tracking, pickup ETAs, SOS.
- [Driver partner app](https://www.adhocx.com/driver-app): onboarding and scheduled corporate trips for commercial cab owners.
- [Drivers](https://www.adhocx.com/drivers): driver partner network and payouts.
